testsuite.name: gspa.cli.ContextCliSpec

testcase.name: CLI context modes preserve every candidate and report the selected relation
a batch with --cohort is two-pass: one snapshot for every genome, then each genome consumes its held-out features
the batch result does not depend on the order of the manifest rows
a single run with a cohort manifest of reference genomes works and a lone genome has no peers
a learned stage that is requested but cannot run fails the command with a ledger, never a silent heuristic run
a failed cohort pass fails the whole batch and every genome ledger says so
cohort options without the reaction bindings are rejected up front
